scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run db:generate && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter @ecogrid/api dev" "pnpm --filter @ecogrid/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm --filter @ecogrid/api build && pnpm --filter @ecogrid/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm --filter @ecogrid/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @ecogrid/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate:postgres: pnpm --filter @ecogrid/api exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:mysql: pnpm --filter @ecogrid/api exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/mysql/schema.prisma
